name: SAS Certified Professional: AI and Machine Learning

entry.name: SAS Certified Professional: AI and Machine Learning
entry.note: Awarded after three SAS specialist credentials: machine learning, forecasting and optimization, and natural language processing and computer vision
entry.renewal: Expires 5 years from the date earned
entry.audience: Analysts and data scientists working in SAS and open source tools

reading.format: Awarded after earning three SAS Certified Specialist credentials. The page mentions exams and practice exams but gives no further assessment details.
reading.summary: This certification validates AI and analytics skills using open source and SAS tools to gain insight from data. It covers natural language processing and computer vision. Candidates earn it after completing three SAS Certified Specialist credentials.
reading.audience: People who want to expand career potential or stand out in a competitive field and who use open source and SAS tools for AI and analytics.
reading.validity: The AI & Machine Learning Professional credential expires five years from the date the certification is earned. Underlying credentials may expire at different times, but that will not cause the AIMLP to expire prior to the five-year date.
reading.prerequisites: Candidates must earn the SAS Certified Specialist: Machine Learning credential, the SAS Certified Specialist: Forecasting and Optimization credential, and the SAS Certified Specialist: Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision credential. The page notes that candidates who hold the SAS Certified Predictive Modeler Using SAS Enterprise Miner (version 7 or higher) credential do not need to take this exam.
